title: CLI throws ParserError on Windows PowerShell 5.1 due to '&&' operator

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report is clear, complete, and actionable. It provides reproduction steps, environment details (Windows PowerShell 5.1), expected behavior, and exact error output showing a ParserError caused by shell command chaining with '&&'.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: While the fix involves updating prompt guidance in snippets.ts, the bug is platform-specific to Windows PowerShell 5.1 where '&&' is unsupported. Per effort guidelines, platform-specific bugs carry testing and cross-environment verification overhead, categorizing it as MEDIUM effort.

summary.problem: The CLI causes a ParserError on Windows when running shell commands chained with the '&&' operator in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
summary.root_cause: The system prompt in renderGitRepo (packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts) explicitly instructs the model to combine shell commands using '&&' (e.g., 'git status && git diff HEAD && git log -n 3'). Windows PowerShell 5.1 does not support '&&' as a statement separator, throwing a ParserError.
summary.context: Windows PowerShell 5.1 is the default shell on Windows 10/11. The '&&' pipeline chain operator was introduced only in PowerShell 7+. To ensure cross-platform shell compatibility, system prompt guidance should instruct running commands as separate sequential calls rather than chaining them with '&&'.

steps: In packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts, update the renderGitRepo prompt snippet to remove instructions recommending command chaining with '&&'.
Update renderGitRepo to instruct executing shell commands sequentially as separate tool calls to ensure compatibility across shells including Windows PowerShell 5.1.
Apply the corresponding prompt instruction update in packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.legacy.ts.
Update any snapshot or prompt unit test assertions in packages/core that check renderGitRepo output.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The system prompt generated by PromptProvider no longer instructs the model to chain commands with '&&', ensuring cross-platform command execution without ParserErrors in PowerShell 5.1.
verification_steps: Verify that the generated core system prompt does not contain 'git status && git diff HEAD && git log -n 3' or '&&' command chaining instructions.
Assert that renderGitRepo output instructs running shell commands sequentially or as separate execution calls.
